notes.title: Devlog #10: New voltiguers unit & cavalry charge - Prototype V0.18
notes.content:
Play the latest version of the prototype here : Itch - Avant-Garde

What's new:

Voltiguers Unit:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/7aab1e4a0e242684e5b00b443c6fed08ddbdebf5.gif
This new light unit has the special ability to form a skirmish formation. This allows soldiers to cover more ground, target multiple enemy units, while suffering few casualties. Artillery fire has little effect on this unit, but close combat attacks can make it easy prey.

Visual changes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/3e7ac29245bef8cd83a2b5ccea733944621d67fe.gif
The terrain has received a visual upgrade in several aspects. First, the textures have been changed to a hand-painted art style. Second, the villages have been reworked to better match the scale of the soldiers. Third, the addition of wheat fields and another type of tree, the oak, further enhances the battlefield.

Cavalry charge:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/33673cdcba0f7900dac1aee2c781c198fa40447a.gif
Cavalry can now charge enemy units! You must, however, choose the right moment to give the charge order, since the unit will quickly exhaust itself and cannot charge indefinitely! A cavalry charge is devastating for all enemy units. The enemy does not yet have the ability to do so, but enemy infantry squares will eventually be able to counter your cavalry charges.


Improved points in this version:

 Soldiers now perfectly follow the terrain.
 Enemy statistics are displayed updated whenever friendly unit formations change.
 Leaving mounts in place can now be performed in the interface at the bottom of the screen.



Corrected bugs:

 There is no longer an infinite loop when a hunter dies.
 The cavalry melee attack animation is now correctly linked.
 Disabling the hunter's stealth formation was never updated in the army overview interface.
 The health bar of buildings was flashing when the mouse was hovering over it.
 The cards for allied reinforcements, in the army overview interface, were not displaying.

notes.title: Devlog #9: New Fighters Unit & Infantry Square - Prototype V0.17
notes.content:
Play the latest version of the prototype here : Itch - Avant-Garde

What's new:

Fighters Unit:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/f685f9a68601f63d1a56e7d4229da63c997c681e.gif
This light infantry unit is born! In addition to being faster and more maneuverable than a standard infantry unit, it has the special ability to become stealthy. This allows h to suffer few losses while ravaging the enemy. Their small number and lack of melee expertise makes them vulnerable to enemy cavalry units.

Infantry Line Formation:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/59459cf30c7244cac7aca6f1188e76ab8628c7a9.gif
Infantry units are now able to form a line. By doing so, it increases its number of shooters and therefore also increases its effectiveness. Be careful, the more shooters there are, the faster the ammunition stock runs out. On the other hand, this formation greatly reduces the unit's movement speed and weakens it in the event of a cavalry attack. There is also a formation delay to take into consideration.

Infantry Square Formation:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/38f7d07dff3b616c15ce6cbdcf3712eb178d6cde.gif
Infantry units can also form the infantry square. After a formation delay, the unit finds itself in a good position to face enemy cavalry charges. However, it becomes easy prey for enemy artillerymen. This formation also allows the unit to shoot at several targets at the same time, since it faces all sides.

Analysis Scene:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/33d065bb441f8e012e0f741e13c89cd079616915.gif
A new scene appears in this version. It allows the player to analyze the terrain and the positioning of allied and enemy units before the start of the battle. Eventually, this is where the player will be able to learn about the context and the point of view of the different nations involved in the battle.


Improved points in this version:

 The soldier who dies is now chosen randomly.
 Optimized the movement system of soldiers in a unit.
 The "halt" order is now always possible if at least one order is in execution.



Corrected bugs:

 The tooltip of the army preview UI was not updating if the special button of a unit header was used.
 Some attacks ordered outside the range were not triggered.
 The visual of the type of the AI staff unit was not visible.

notes.title: Devlog #8 : Grapeshot and mini map - Prototype V0.16
notes.content:
Play the latest version of the prototype here : Itch - Avant-Garde

What's new:

Mini map:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/5ceb22598aae76d9ee2694006e5cccbccba867e4.gif
In the upper right corner there is now a mini map. This map displays where the known units are. It is possible to move the camera around it with a left click and to zoom in on it with a right click. For better visibility, it is also possible to enlarge it and even hide it.

Artillery Grapeshot:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/56075afa16ff7bc08e89eaabfc324b9251b3e8bd.gif
Artillery finally has a special ability, grapeshot. Allowing to do a lot of damage over a short distance, this option is ideal for defending against enemy cavalry and infantry. The number of ammunition is not considered to be the same as that of cannonballs. Which can become an option if no more cannonballs left.

Retreat Order:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/e6a59a7db951085381a8ff40f12213afaa5bd185.gif
You can now order your units to retreat. By doing so, they will immediately leave the battlefield. This is an option that allows you to limit losses in the event of unavoidable defeats. Eventually, this could also affect your numbers in the next battle.

Loading Screen:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/1a0bb0efd8aab110dd99fea1c2da11203d3d1f31.gif
Here is finally the feedback that tells you that the button you clicked to start the game is working. It's very basic for now, but it does the trick!


Improved points in this version:

 Unit special buttons now appear in the main interface at the bottom.
 Better calculations and distributions of unit reload times.
 Possible keyboard shortcut to speed up or slow down time (p, [, ], <) on qwerty.
 User interface (UI) rework.


Corrected bugs: 

 The pause menu now appears above all other UIs.
 The button to run the unit works again.
 Clicking the arrow to hide unit cards no longer deselects the selected unit.
 There are no more issues with the tutorial dialogs displaying.

notes.title: Devlog #7: External Environment - Prototype V0.15
notes.content:
Play the latest version of the prototype here : Itch - Avant-Garde

What's new:

External environment:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/0fc1aa0b8f49a68e4bb79b4af45eadb6a0135e98.gif
The external environment adds to the context of the game, where each battle is represented in the form of a board game. When you pause time, you see the game as it really is. By starting the game time again, you let your imagination take over and thus see the board game come to life, simulating the historical battle.

External representation of events:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/3e22a24eba8b57136754c5cf768f3ff616bedbe7.gif
The external environment will adapt and represent what is happening on the game board. Whether it is the atmosphere, the light, the weather or the events that take place during the battle. For example, in this version, the building that catches fire and makes smoke is represented by a candle in "the real world" when time is paused.

Ambient Occlusion:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/863c763537d01e3f2c68fce0f4f04d01eebe6bd6.gif
This is the kind of thing that is easy to implement and adds a lot to the game. Until now there were very few, if any, of them. The time has come to spice it up.

Improved points in this version:

 Fixes in the tutorial.
 Texture optimizations.


Corrected bugs:

 No more dialogs appeared after closing a dialog.
 The dialog box was superimposed with the enemy card game.
 The height of the headquarters header did not adjust when paused.
 It was no longer possible to press the run button.
 Clicking on the time control buttons deselects the units.
 Enemy units annihilated, immobilized allied units that targeted them.
 The buttons to recover/destroy artillery were partly hidden by the ground.

notes.title: Devlog #6 : Units Cards Decks & Input Rebinding - Prototype V0.14!
notes.content:
Play the latest version of the prototype here : Itch - Avant-Garde

What's new:

Units Cards Decks:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/4381cb2b92e0835b4c276c89945c88c7f6b80be2.gif
Each card in your hand corresponds to a unit in your army. Your deck of cards allows you to have an overview of the state of your army, and to give your orders directly to them. You can also see your enemy's deck of cards in order to better understand the situation. Card decks take up space on the screen, so it is possible to hide and display them as you wish.

Events Notification System:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/1e1b86529ad9ed37a52ff4cfcde91a970137b16a.gif
Notifications appear on the left side of the screen to keep you informed of major events that occur during the battle. Double-clicking on them displays the explanatory dialogue, in addition to showing you the topic in question. A simple right-click allows you to dismiss the notification.

Attack Confirmation :
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/2f96f4b0874008dd6f6bb088df1e5f8a9256b920.gif
When you ask one or more units to attack an enemy, a sword will be planted in the hex where the enemy unit is located. This is to let you know that the attack has indeed been taken into account.

Basic Tutorial :
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/846ad8a6c5c9a71c48d3fd6baad858ec4b71fc52.gif
There is now a basic tutorial that allows you to understand the basic actions and mechanics of the game. Over the versions, this tutorial will be more and more detailed.

Input Rebinding :
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/e88be343794f8c14b698172f14545ce257a7a62c.gif
Great news! You can now rebind the keys that are bound to different actions in the game in the controls menu. Currently, some actions do not allow you to change keys, but it is only a matter of time before this will be possible for these actions.


Improved points in this version:

 Split the enemy stat card.
 Changed the position of the clock UI.
 Improved visibility on the clock.
 Double-clicking on the unit itself allows you to focus in on it.
 Ability to select two units from opposing sides to compare their stats. 
 Added a tooltips appearance delay.


Corrected bugs:

 In the previous version, attacking buildings/bridges was made almost impossible.
 The Commander-in-Chief icon was not appearing on the unit's stat card.
 Minor bugs.

notes.title: Taking part of the "Back to School Games Celebration" event on Steam!
notes.content:
Avant-Garde was part of the Steam “Back to School Games Celebration” event!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/ed0bfeb9d3dfb410447b180852143d0aff0c609b.png

This event was intended to celebrate educational video games, from near and far. From programming logic games to games that stimulate productivity. As you might expect, Avant-Garde was in the "History and Geography" category.

Here is the Steam event in question: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/BacktoSchoolSale2024


But why was Avant-Garde part of such an event?

Sure, Avant-Garde is a real-time strategy game, but that doesn't mean it doesn't have an educational flavor. Let me explain... My goal is to use the video game as an interactive historical documentary.

Basically, Avant-Garde allows you to discover, understand and interact with the different events that shaped the outcome of the chosen battle. It's up to you to see if you do better, or worse, than the commander-in-chief you play. At least you have the advantage of being able to start over if things didn't go well.

The game is still in the prototyping phase (pre-alpha). Soon the time will come to implement the story into the game mechanics. Not being a historian myself, I have collaborated and will continue to do so, with historians to get the real story on the course and context of specific battles.

There you have it, now you know the primary goal of Avant-Garde and what you will face when playing it!

Thank you to all those who believe in the project by wishlisting it on Steam. Your support is essential for the success of the game.

Take care!

Thomas

notes.title: Devlog #5 : Weather & Key Events - Prototype V0.13!
notes.content:
Play the latest version of the prototype here : Itch - Avant-Garde

Avant-Garde will immerse you in battles where you will have to deal with the same conditions and resources as back then. You will therefore be able to discover, understand and interact with the battle you have chosen.

What's new:

Weather:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/e1efe27f9d7cdf7ffe46ef5b6c249713c543c599.gif
There is now a weather system on the battlefield. You will experience the same weather as the commander you represent on the battlefield. The question is: will you adapt better than him? Eventually the weather will affect the terrain, the morale of your troops and their effectiveness.

Key events:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/1cc409533359776beffd79c48b8df4d530791f2b.gif
Still with the aim of making you experience the battles of the time, you must now also face the various events that marked the course of the battle. Indeed, the enemy can set fire to a farm and the resulting smoke could block your field of vision. It is up to you to decide whether you want to deploy units to prevent them or if it is not worth it. After all, it is now up to you to write history.

Improved points in this version:

 The end screen appears quicker.
 Better dialog system, not pausing the game, with the possibility of focusing on the subject of the said dialog.
 You can now focus on enemy units.
 Better shadows' quality.
 Anti-aliasing added.


Corrected bugs:

 Minor bugs.

notes.title: Devlog #4 : Buildings and explosions - Prototype V0.12!
notes.content:
Test the latest version of the prototype here: Itch - Avant-Garde

What's new:

Buildings:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/45b371682239f64b6309cf1cb040ddaeefb68c22.gif
There are now buildings on the battlefield. When a unit enters it, it gains a serious defensive advantage. Be careful, however, not to leave your unit in the building when it collapses. The same goes for bridges. Bridges and buildings can be targeted by artillery fire.

Leave horses/cannons behind:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/cb373df0de17502348a83ef8bb4a5d4cb8ab3348.gif
Artillery and cavalry units can now separate from their mounts. Useful when your cannons are running out of ammo. Riders can recover unmounted horses, and gunners can recover loose cannons. All units have the option to destroy the cannons or free the horses.

Cannonballs dirt explosions:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/6a6b8116765475f3419632c1af815d3c40ba5750.gif
This time, the cannonballs cause a small dirt explosion when they hit the terrain. This is a minor change that adds a lot to the game. Also, before this version, damage from artillery fire was applied when firing the cannonball. Now they are applied when the cannonball hits the ground.

Improved points in this version:

 The clock is more precise, making up for the difference in rotation with the sun in the scene.
 The sun rotates continuously and no longer step by step (in a discreet manner) as before.
 Artillery damage is calculated on impact of the cannonball and no longer at the time of firing.


Corrected bugs: 

 The automatic attack always ended up being the one recalculated, even after a specific attack order.
 Other minor bugs.

notes.title: Devlog #3 : Advanced Moral System - Prototype V0.11!
notes.content:
Test the latest version of the prototype here: Itch - Avant-Garde

What's new:

Unit Orientation:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/f81ffc5709a24a158a3df89f6c87770ca576d9c8.gif
You can now choose the orientation your unit is facing while waiting for orders. Why is this useful? Well, orientation affects moral. If your unit is being attack from behind, it will suffer way more moral losses than if it was attacked from the front. There are three zones. The front: green, the flanks: orange and the rear: red. Being flanked isn't fun, but being attacked on the back is something you really want to avoid! To rotate your unit, use the mouse scroll wheel, while pressing left alt key, as you hover the unit in question.

View Cell Bonuses:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/24bae44811e067fff36c8dac418fc935b7f07288.gif
Pressing left alt key will show you alternative information in the game. For instance, it will show you the bonuses a cell gives to a unit. If you pressed left alt key on a cell containing a unit, you'll be able to see the moral range mentioned earlier.

Visible Bullets :
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/fbb2b9aa51c1b8e285396b2259c159fc5623fc77.gif
This is something I should have implemented earlier in the game... You can now see visible bullet trails when units are firing at each other. At least this is a start!

Targeted Enemy Unit FeedBack:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/861a7737160bf4516c81d6c09dfb88371fc84ebc.gif
I've added some feedback to help you see when your targeting a specific enemy unit. When you see this, it means your unit has locked the said enemy unit and is going toward it.

Improved points in this version:

 The unit header is better defined, making it easier to select cells around it.
 Pressing alt while having an enemy unit selected shows its attack range preview at the hovered cell.
 Better explanation of the moral in its tool tip.
 More situations are taken into account when calculating morale.
 Double clicking on a cell makes your selected units run.
 Better color differentiation between the two armies.
 Attack range visibility improved.


Corrected bugs: 

 The preview of the range of a unit does not appear in the center of the map when the mouse leaves the board.
 Other minor bugs

notes.title: Devlog #2 : New Staff Unit Available - Prototype V0.10!
notes.content:
Test the latest version of the prototype here: Itch - Avant-Garde

What's new:
New Staff Unit:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/5575c6553f6dc84844eb9a9425e7a62e1309168a.gif
Each army now has one staff unit. This unit contains the general of the army. If the general dies, every units of the army will see their moral drops a little.
Special Ability:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/27ae4d03e1c66e4696a80f9cf3ec224957b23233.gif
One day, every unit will have a special action you will be able to activate. For now, only the staff unit can enjoy this ability. Activating it will boost the moral of every unit within the special ability range.

Improved points in this version:

 Soldiers within a unit are now shown by step of 5.

Corrected bugs: 

 The ennemy cavalery unit isn't moving by itself anymore while the game is paused.

notes.title: Devlog #1: New Unit Available - Prototype V0.09!
notes.content:
Test the lastest version of the prototype here : Itch - Avant-Garde

What's new:
Cavalery Units:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/aa7a2464374484496b8a221ac0c0c93cfc22e0b9.gif
It's about time! The cavalry units are here. They make up for their lack of soldiers with their speed. Be careful not to leave your artilleries alone, or they could be their next preys.
Automatic attack mode:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/9c79a739b53c92cac424506575a383a617071020.gif
A simple right-click on the enemy allows the selected unit to best attack the enemy. So, for example, a cavalry unit will automatically attack artillery through its melee attack.
Precise Attack Mode:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683441/2ed15b29c048bb82102a72165fcc8688e08fe957.gif
The precise attack mode was present by default in previous versions. It has now been changed to match the automatic attack mode. To activate it, simply hold down the right-click to quickly bring up the attack buttons. Then simply select the desired distance or type of attack.

Improved points: 

AI no longer simply follow a path, they also target your units according to their weaknesses.
Unit selection is also possible via the unit header (UI).
Dead units are indicated as such on their card on the table.

Corrected bugs:

Once a focused unit is killed, the game doesnot crashed anymore.
It's now possible to unfocus a unit even if it's deselected.
